//: Example telemetry input for `quota-axi prime` (ADR 0031, Phase 2).
//realWorkPending: Optional. When true and prefer_real_work is on, needy accounts defer to real-work routing instead of a synthetic ping. Defaults to false (idle fleet).
//telemetry: Per fixed-cost-account priming telemetry keyed by registry account id. `freshness: unknown` (or a missing entry) marks the account for priming. `authVerified` reports whether the local credential is verified. `ageSeconds` is telemetry age; at or beyond the strategy's max_telemetry_age_seconds it is stale. `windows` (remaining-percent per window id) drives only the real-work routing preference.
